{
  "categories": [
    {
      "name": "kernel",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches src/kernel/bitcoinkernel.cpp only via mechanical scripted updates from .stack to CScriptWitness accessors.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Does not change the kernel API, boundary, or library behavior; changes are purely mechanical call-site updates."
    },
    {
      "name": "mempool",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches src/policy/policy.cpp only to update calls to CScriptWitness accessors.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Does not alter mempool data structures, policy rules, eviction, or package evaluation."
    },
    {
      "name": "mining",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches src/node/miner.cpp only for witness accessor method migration.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Does not alter block template generation, fee accounting, or mining interfaces."
    },
    {
      "name": "p2p",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Modifies P2P message deserialization in src/net_processing.cpp to track weight limits and drop malformed transactions.",
      "band": "P1",
      "score": 0.8,
      "reason_tag": "DoS protection",
      "rationale": "Prevents peers from inducing extreme memory allocations via network streams before validation rejects them. P2P deserialization now decrements a weight budget to reject over-weight blocks/transactions and immediately drops transactions with zero inputs or outputs."
    },
    {
      "name": "rpc",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches src/rpc/rawtransaction.cpp and related files only to adapt to the new CScriptWitness API.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Does not change RPC interfaces, formats, or behavior; changes are mechanical call-site adjustments."
    },
    {
      "name": "tests",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Adds benchmarks and fuzz targets specific to the new witness layout rather than changing general test framework machinery.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "test coverage",
      "rationale": "The test additions and harness updates follow directly from the witness serialization change rather than modifying test infrastructure itself."
    },
    {
      "name": "tools",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches src/bitcoin-tx.cpp only to adapt to CScriptWitness accessor methods.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Contains no substantive changes or improvements to CLI developer tools."
    },
    {
      "name": "utils",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Changes shared stream and serialization primitives in src/serialize.h and src/streams.h.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.65,
      "reason_tag": "DoS protection",
      "rationale": "Hardens shared serialization primitives against vector pre-allocation exhaustion attacks. Core serialization routines are updated to prevent peers from requesting allocations larger than what can fit in valid protocol messages."
    },
    {
      "name": "validation",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Alters CScriptWitness storage, transaction primitives in src/primitives/transaction.h, and block validation deserialization in src/validation.cpp.",
      "band": "P1",
      "score": 0.88,
      "reason_tag": "DoS protection",
      "rationale": "Resolves a reported vulnerability where worst-case valid 4 MB blocks with millions of small witness elements consume over 180 MiB of peak RAM and hundreds of milliseconds to deserialize. Benchmarks demonstrate that persisting witness stacks in serialized wire form drops worst-case deserialization from 279 ms to 19 ms, peak memory from 182 MiB to 7.8 MiB, and persisted memory from 106.8 MiB to 3.8 MiB."
    },
    {
      "name": "wallet",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches wallet files and PSBT handling solely for CScriptWitness accessor updates.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Does not alter wallet logic, coin selection, database storage, or key management."
    }
  ],
  "factors": {
    "security_stability": 3,
    "bug_severity": 2,
    "performance": 2,
    "user_value": 0,
    "leverage": 1
  }
}
